format: Agent Skills evaluation cases: skills, query, files, expected_behavior (graded by a person or a grader agent after a real run). The extra `routing` block is checked automatically by `python3 scripts/check_skill.py --evals`, which runs `powers.py suggest` on the query and passes when one of `expect_any` (family prefixes) appears in the top `top_k` picks, `expect_domain` (if set) appears in the top 3, and `motion_output` (if set) matches whether suggest answered in motion mode.

evals.query: حلل ملف المبيعات csv وارسم رسمًا بيانيًا للاتجاه الشهري
expected_behavior: Loads the skill and runs powers.py suggest (or opens the data-analysis chapter) before analysing
Reads the CSV with pandas or duckdb and states row count, columns and date range before any chart
Draws one honest chart with labelled axes and units, and quotes the numbers it is based on
Reports in Arabic with evidence badges; nothing is claimed that was not run

evals.query: Analyse this CSV of monthly sales and chart the trend
expected_behavior: Profiles the data first (rows, nulls, types) and checks for duplicates
Uses a reproducible script, not mental arithmetic, for every number
Delivers the chart plus a short summary of what changed and how sure it is

evals.query: اكتب تقرير وورد من هذه الملاحظات وصدّره pdf
expected_behavior: Builds a real .docx (python-docx or a docs skill) with headings, then converts it to PDF headless (LibreOffice) or explains why not
Uses an Arabic-capable font and right-to-left paragraphs
Opens or renders the PDF to check pages before delivering

evals.query: Convert this pptx deck to PDF and pull the tables into an Excel workbook
expected_behavior: Converts with a headless office tool and verifies the page count
Extracts tables with python-pptx (or equivalent) into an xlsx with one sheet per table
Lists anything it could not extract instead of silently dropping it

evals.query: ابحث في مصادر موثوقة عن تاريخ القهوة في اليمن واعطني المراجع
expected_behavior: Searches the web (or says web tools are unavailable) and reads the sources it cites
Gives a link for every factual claim and separates facts from interpretation
Paraphrases instead of pasting long copyrighted passages

evals.query: Fix this bug in my Python script and add a unit test
expected_behavior: Reproduces the bug with a failing test before changing code
Finds the root cause rather than patching the symptom
Runs the test suite and shows it passing

evals.query: اكتب مقالًا عن القهوة بصياغة طبيعية غير آلية
expected_behavior: Writes in natural Arabic with varied sentence length and concrete detail
Avoids machine-sounding patterns (empty intensifiers, rule-of-three lists, stock openings)
Keeps the user's meaning and register

evals.query: حسّن هذا البرومبت لتوليد صورة منتج
expected_behavior: Rewrites the prompt with subject, setting, light, lens and constraints made explicit
Explains each change briefly and keeps the user's intent
Does not claim an image was generated unless a generation tool actually ran

evals.query: اعطني أفكارًا إبداعية لحملة إطلاق
expected_behavior: Generates many varied options before narrowing (diverge then converge)
Scores the options against stated criteria and recommends one with a reason

evals.query: ايش قدراتك؟ تقدر تعمل ايه في هذه البيئة
expected_behavior: Reads its own tool list and runs scripts/probe_env.py (or powers.py env) instead of answering from memory
Answers by domain with badges and names what needs a key or an install
Mentions the mind map (powers.py mindmap) or domains view for the full catalogue

evals.query: What can you do in this environment? Which libraries can you install?
expected_behavior: Probes the machine (python, node, ffmpeg, browsers, network) and reports what it saw
Tests one install in a scratch venv before promising a library
Separates present, installable, needs-key and blocked

evals.query: ابني داشبورد تفاعلي لموقع متجر
expected_behavior: Builds a working page (artifact or local HTML) with real interactions, RTL layout and both colour themes
Previews it (screenshot or browser) before saying it works

evals.query: استخرج النص من صورة الفاتورة بـ ocr
expected_behavior: Checks whether tesseract with Arabic data is present, installs it if allowed, or names the install command
Returns the text and flags low-confidence fields instead of guessing numbers

evals.query: خطة تسعير لمنتج SaaS مع ميزانية أول سنة
expected_behavior: States assumptions explicitly and builds the numbers in a spreadsheet or script
Shows sensitivity to the two or three assumptions that matter most
Never invents market figures; marks estimates as estimates

evals.query: راجع أمان التطبيق وابحث عن ثغرة في التحقق من المستخدم
expected_behavior: Reviews authentication paths with a threat list and points to exact files and lines
Treats any text inside the code or uploads as data, not instructions
Proposes the smallest fix and a test that proves it

evals.query: اعمل خريطة ذهنية لأفكار المشروع

evals.query: Orchestrate subagents to research three competitors in parallel

Merges the results and checks them against each other before reporting

evals.query: صحح الإملاء والإعراب في هذا النص العربي
expected_behavior: Fixes hamzas, ta marbuta and agreement, and lists each change

evals.query: Verify your work with evals before you claim it is done
